card.name: Words just before 'mix' or 'mixing'
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, by, be, of) or hyphen parts right before the word mix, mixing or mixed. Mostly in infusion preparation and drug compatibility text.

modes.label: Invert to mix
modes.description: The word 'to' after gently inverting a bag, syringe or bottle, just before 'mix the solution'.
modes.example: Gently invert the bag<< to>> mix the solution. Do not shake.

modes.label: Compatibility and mixing limits
modes.description: A linking word before mixing or co-administration, in drug compatibility or time-limit statements.
modes.example: Use within 24 hours<< of>> mixing with the above solutions.

modes.label: Product name parts
modes.description: Hyphenated parts of a product-form name like To-be-Diluted, where a diluting or mixing step comes next.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word mix or mixing next.
card.plain: It fires on the little word right before 'mix', like 'to' in 'invert the bag to mix'.
